checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Speaker is the curly-haired woman in the portrait
must.why: Same face, hair, sweater and park background in all frames.

must.item: Complete script spoken exactly, no extra words
must.why: Audio not transcribed; the agent says the script was passed verbatim, but this can't be verified.

must.item: Mouth visibly moves in sync with speech
must.why: At 3.2s the mouth is open mid-speech and at 0.8s, 5.6s and 7.6s it is closed. Sync can't be fully checked.

must.item: One square, 8-second video with audible friendly female English speech
must.why: The frames are square and the clip is stated as 8s. Speech is likely present, but I can't hear it. The agent says it ends with a pause.
No text appears in any frame.

exact_text.text: Hi everyone! Thanks for stopping by. I can't wait to show you what's new.
exact_text.read_as: No on-screen text; correct, since no captions were requested. The words are only spoken, which I can't verify.

faults.what: Speech may end well before 8 seconds. The agent admits this, and the frames at 5.6s and 7.6s show a closed, still mouth, so the tail is idle.
Slight softness and AI smoothing in the face. Identity is preserved.

summary: The output is a clean square talking-head video of the same woman, with no captions and visible mouth movement. The words spoken and the voice quality can't be checked, and the ending is idle.
